node.statement: The rows p_{u_0}, p_{u_1}, p_{u_2} form an ordered basis of the row space, so coordinates in that basis are unique. The standard expansion of p_{u_r} is p_{u_r} = sum_q delta_{q r} p_{u_q}. Comparing this expansion with p_{u_r} = sum_q (sum_i beta_r(i)*a_q(i)) p_{u_q} gives sum_i beta_r(i)*a_q(i) = delta_{q r} for every q in {0,1,2}, and in particular sum_i beta_r(i)*a_s(i) = delta_{s r}.
